codex_note:
## Codex security hold

The bundled [read-only structural auditor](scripts/cursor_plugin_submission_audit.py) checks local manifest JSON, bounded component paths, frontmatter field presence, and README presence in synthetic fixtures. `STRUCTURAL_PASS` is not a submission recommendation: full YAML validity, marketplace source/name uniqueness, documentation quality, runtime behavior, and policy review remain unproven. Hook and `mcpServers` surfaces are reported as `REVIEW_REQUIRED` and never executed by this adapter. The needs_human_review source finding is retained; this candidate remains unindexed.
